_comment: Supervised Controller — Tunable Allowlist and Safety Bounds. NEVER edit forbidden_params section. Hard risk limits are enforced by risk_engine regardless.

SIGNAL_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD.description: Min signal confidence required to open a position

EXEC_MIN_EDGE.description: Min net edge (after fees + slippage) to place an order

CLONE_SCORE_THRESHOLD.description: Min composite score for clone opportunity entry

CLONE_AGGRESSIVENESS.description: Clone size multiplier (1.0 = match profile exactly)

CLONE_COMBINED_PRICE_MIN.description: HF pair entry band floor (YES_ask + NO_ask)

CLONE_SIZE_MIN_USDC.description: Clone sizer absolute floor per trade

CLONE_SIZE_MAX_USDC.description: Clone sizer absolute ceiling per trade (before stage cap)

_note_live_code_patching: Live code patching is DISABLED by design. The controller may only write to logs/applied_params.json. The operator must restart the bot to pick up new params.
